pytest_installation: Environment-only in finsearch-arm; repository dependency files unchanged.
final_review_fixes: Structured lanes with zero admitted evidence remain partial only when every requested operation returned partial; partial mixed with error, ambiguous, or unsupported outcomes now fails closed.
Every whole-lane structured classification now requires exact requested/result coverage. Incomplete results are usable partial when admitted evidence survives and failed when none survives.
Malformed structured result entries and invalid result containers count as attempted failures, produce normalized admission issues, and serialize safely for independent shadow evaluation.
The deterministic matrix adds a mixed partial-plus-error structured-only case that must be failed, unusable, and analyst-skipped.
